g.text: SCR06 — Call logs
Kotlin Compose screen definition · design only · Per-client logging / FR-KT-02
Service Running (desired running) · MCP ready · ADB offline · view ready · catalog ready · ARC disabled · r9-ready
Wide layout: persistent rail + scrollable list/detail; control contracts
SCR06.C01 · Inspect record
Exact named action; protected mutations open SCR09; reads never
change authority
SCR06.C02 · Export selected scope
Exact named action; protected mutations open SCR09; reads never
change authority
SCR06.C03 · Open navigation
Drawer on phone; rail on wide layout. Destinations
SCR01..SCR08,SCR10,SCR11; Back discards only after explicit
discard/cancel decision.
SCR06.C04 · Filter logs
Owner selects client/time/outcome; redacted bounded snapshot
SCR06.C05 · Choose export document
Android SAF create-document after protected exact-snapshot
approval
SCR06.C06 · Edit retention quotas
Protected settings review; mandatory audit reserve and optional-
log quotas separate
SCR06.C07 · Cancel export
No document written; release sealed export snapshot
Phone · 390dp single pane
☰ Menu · SCR06 · status
Menu opens all destinations in a
modal drawer. Filters precede a
paged list. Selecting a row
replaces list with detail; Back
returns list. Scroll retains draft
and focused field.
SCR06.C01 · primary action
48dp targets; no compressed rail
All wide-layout control IDs map to
the same actions here. State
enablement below is authoritative.
State definitions — enabled controls, effects and recovery
SCR06.S0 · Depicted normal/example state
Disabled: none except standard permission/target readiness gates. Read-only until exact protected commit; error/conflict never applies a partial mutation. Owner may inspect
reason, explicitly retry when safe, or cancel/discard; no automatic uncertain write replay.
SCR06.S1 · Empty: no admitted calls
Disabled: SCR06.C02, SCR06.C05. Read-only until exact protected commit; error/conflict never applies a partial mutation. Owner may inspect reason, explicitly retry when safe, or
cancel/discard; no automatic uncertain write replay.
SCR06.S2 · Denied: export needs owner auth
Disabled: none except standard permission/target readiness gates. Read-only until exact protected commit; error/conflict never applies a partial mutation. Owner may inspect
reason, explicitly retry when safe, or cancel/discard; no automatic uncertain write replay.
SCR06.S3 · Disk quota: visible retention error
Disabled: SCR06.C02, SCR06.C05. Read-only until exact protected commit; error/conflict never applies a partial mutation. Owner may inspect reason, explicitly retry when safe, or
cancel/discard; no automatic uncertain write replay.
SCR06.S4 · Export approved: Android create-document picker; cancel writes nothing
Disabled: none except standard permission/target readiness gates. Read-only until exact protected commit; error/conflict never applies a partial mutation. Owner may inspect
reason, explicitly retry when safe, or cancel/discard; no automatic uncertain write replay.
